unresolved.reason: Decree 1663/2005 names Andorran citizens and a 90-day waiver, but Rada assigns the instrument an indeterminate legal status rather than an affirmative in-force status. No current official Andorran or Ukrainian passport-specific visitor source independently establishes the route.
